sections.title: Identification
sections.text: This catalogue entry refers to Larix decidua, the European larch, and is not a species distinct from the Larix decidua entry. The two pages therefore link to each other. The genus-level illustration alone does not identify a species.

sections.title: Form and needles
sections.text: European larch is a large deciduous conifer, usually 15–22 m tall and 7–10 m wide. Its soft needles, 2.5–3.5 cm long, grow in dense clusters on short shoots and turn yellow before falling in autumn.

sections.title: Cones and uses
sections.text: The small upright female cones are about 2.5–4 cm long. Its timber is used in construction. No part is presented here as food.
